name: Hybrid Surface-Volume Rendering with Masking and Early Ray Termination
aliases: Fast Surface and Volume Rendering Based on Shear-Warp Factorization
definition: A rendering method combining a volume-rendered organ image and a surface-rendered instrument image. It reduces computation by using early ray termination for the volume part and masking the sheared image space for the instrument part, updating only the instrument's motion area.
summary: This method accelerates hybrid volume and surface rendering by combining early ray termination with spatial masking in sheared image space to limit recomputation to affected pixels.
